title: Needs you
how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: For the texturing test's verdict on Wednesday: sign in on fab.com in your own browser, open each of the five links, and press 'Add to My Library' on each (all free). Then tap Done. Nothing is bought; the session downloads them into the test project itself.

links.label: Brick Wall Worn (the brick to beat)
Leakage (the grime stain for both bricks)
Industrial Junkyard Crate Metal (the second prop)
Flaked Paint Wall (chips for the shop front's paint)

sections.recommendation: Done, about five minutes: without these the brick and prop chains have nothing to be compared against, and the verdict would be half a test.
